name: approval-timeout-approve
description: The ticket 15.4 auto-approve-on-timeout demonstration: a `human_approval` gate whose `on_timeout` policy is `approve` (documented as dangerous — a side effect fires with no human in the loop; only for gates where "no answer means go"). On park the executor schedules an expiry through the delayed queue due at `timeout_at`; when it fires, the timeout policy auto-approves the ORIGINAL payload (never an edit) through the same single-arbiter CAS a human decision uses, records the approval `expired` with `decision: approve` / `source: timeout` / `decided_by: system:timeout`, and `publish` consumes the approved payload. A human decision arriving first wins the CAS and best-effort cancels the pending expiry.
